title: Purdue researchers get NIH grant to prepare next generation of biomedical scientists
summary_en: Purdue Engineers have been awarded a training grant by the National Institute of General Medical Sciences to prepare graduate students to fill the growing national need for scientists who can lead the design, characterization and application of engineered biological systems.
title_cn: Purdue researchers get NIH grant to prepare next generation of biomedical scientists

title: Civil engineering lab is latest Purdue facility to achieve internationally recognized quality management certification
summary_en: Credential will help facilitate partnerships with construction and nuclear industries

title: Motorsports engineering student in Indianapolis put to the test in short-track racing
summary_en: Growing up in Illinois, aspiring race car driver Noah Eisenhower has competed at some of the toughest short tracks in the country. But he has a secret weapon: a Purdue education in Motorsports Engineering.
